stories.title: Michael Thorbjornsen Wins the Rocket Classic — First PGA Tour Win in 65 Starts (T1 — FRESH)

x_posts.label: Post 1-1
x_posts.text:
Michael Thorbjornsen wins the Rocket Classic. 🏆

65th PGA Tour start. First win.

18-under 262. Final round 7-under 63. Beat Schauffele by 2.

$1.8M and 500 FedEx Cup points — playoffs secured.

The last-ever Rocket Classic went to a first-time winner.

#RocketClassic #PGATour

x_posts.label: Post 1-2
x_posts.text:
Thorbjornsen at the Rocket Classic:

65 starts. No wins.

Then: 7-under 63 in the final round of the last Rocket Classic ever held.

$1,800,000. 500 FedEx Cup points. Playoff spot locked.

The tournament ends. A career gets started. 🏌️

#PGATour
